title: Topolons: Stable Particle-Like Remnants of Collapsed Vacuum Bubbles in a Three-Form Gauge Sector
summary: We study a three-form gauge sector in four spacetime dimensions coupled to electrically charged spherical membranes with Dirac--Born--Infeld (DBI) worldvolume dynamics. The associated four-form field strength has no local propagating degrees of freedom and contributes a branch-dependent vacuum energy. Motivated by the Hartle--Hawking--Wu selection argument, we restrict to the semiclassically admissible flux window and endow the membrane with a worldvolume $U(1)$ gauge field carrying quantized monopole flux $n\in\mathbb{Z}$.
